text:
Decision: Focus first on GitHub and Reddit as our primary sources for AI info mining.

Reason: Both platforms have high-quality, developer-driven discussions and real-world projects. GitHub gives us code and project details, while Reddit offers unfiltered user feedback and trends. This combo covers both technical depth and community sentiment.

Trade-off: We’re skipping Product Hunt and Telegram for now to keep the scope tight and deliver something solid quickly. If we hit our quality bar, we can expand later.
